title: Recover From AGV Motionless on Floor Fault (Locate AGV, E-stop Zone, Remove, Reset)
summary: For an AGV that is motionless on the floor due to a fault, locate the faulted AGV (optionally using RMS for AGV error), stop the appropriate E-stop zone, remove the faulted AGV, pull E-STOP, and press the blue RESET button to resume operation.
when_to_use: Use when an AGV is motionless on the floor due to a fault and the system needs to be recovered so operation can resume.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Executes on-site recovery actions (identify faulted AGV, stop the appropriate E-stop zone, remove the faulted AGV, pull E-STOP, press blue RESET).
safety_notes: This procedure includes stopping an E-stop zone and pulling E-STOP; ensure safe physical handling and follow site safety practices while performing on-floor actions.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to the appropriate E-STOP controls
RMS / fleet status UI (if needed to identify the faulted AGV error)

access_required: Physical access to the appropriate E-STOP controls
Access to RMS / fleet status UI (optional, for identifying the faulted AGV error)
system_preconditions: An AGV is motionless on the floor due to a fault.

steps.title: Locate the faulted AGV
steps.purpose: Identify which AGV is faulted and motionless so the correct E-stop zone can be stopped and the correct unit removed.
steps.instruction: Locate the faulted AGV on the floor. If needed to identify the faulted AGV error, use the RMS / fleet status UI to determine which AGV is faulted.
steps.expected_result: You have identified the specific faulted AGV that is motionless on the floor.
steps.healthy_condition: The faulted AGV is correctly identified (not a different AGV) so the correct E-stop zone can be stopped.
steps.failure_condition: The wrong AGV is identified (leading to stopping the wrong E-stop zone or removing the wrong unit).

actions.label: Identify faulted AGV
actions.exact_action: Locate the faulted AGV (may need to reference RMS for AGV error).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: AGV motionless on floor: Fault. 1. Locate the faulted AGV (may need to reference RMS for AGV error).

steps.title: Stop the appropriate E-stop zone
steps.purpose: Stop motion in the correct zone to make the faulted AGV safe to remove and to prevent further system movement in that area.
steps.instruction: Reference the E-stop zone map and press E-STOP to stop the appropriate E-stop zone for the faulted AGV.
steps.expected_result: The appropriate E-stop zone is stopped (E-STOP action applied to the correct zone).
steps.healthy_condition: E-STOP is applied to the correct zone corresponding to the faulted AGV location.
steps.failure_condition: E-STOP is applied to the wrong zone or the zone does not stop as intended.

actions.label: Stop E-stop zone
actions.exact_action: Reference E-stop zone map. Press E-STOP to stop the appropriate E-stop zone.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: AGV motionless on floor: Fault. 2. Reference E-stop zone map. Press E-STOP to stop the appropriate E-stop zone.

steps.title: Remove the faulted AGV
steps.purpose: Physically remove the faulted AGV from the system so it can be handled/recovered and the system can be reset.
steps.instruction: Remove the faulted AGV from the floor/system area.
steps.expected_result: The faulted AGV has been removed.
steps.healthy_condition: The faulted AGV is no longer present in the zone where it was motionless.
steps.failure_condition: The faulted AGV remains in place or cannot be safely removed.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: AGV motionless on floor: Fault. 3. Remove the faulted AGV.

steps.title: Pull E-STOP and press blue RESET
steps.purpose: Clear the fault state and bring the system back to a state where operation can resume.
steps.instruction: Pull E-STOP, then press the blue RESET button.
steps.expected_result: The blue RESET button is pressed after pulling E-STOP.
steps.healthy_condition: RESET is applied as the final recovery action in the sequence.
steps.failure_condition: RESET is not pressed (or is pressed without pulling E-STOP as required by the sequence).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: AGV motionless on floor: Fault. 4. Pull E-STOP. 5. Press the blue RESET button.

steps.title: Verify the system resumes operation
steps.purpose: Confirm recovery succeeded and the system is back in operation.
steps.instruction: Observe the system after pressing blue RESET to confirm it resumes operation.
steps.healthy_condition: Operation continues after RESET (system is no longer in the faulted motionless condition).
steps.failure_condition: The system does not resume operation after RESET.

actions.label: Confirm resume
actions.exact_action: Observe that the system resumes operation.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the system does not resume operation after RESET, stop and escalate to a supervisor/support for further troubleshooting.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: AGV motionless on floor: Fault. 6. The system will resume operation.

success_criteria: After pressing the blue RESET button, the system resumes operation.
failure_conditions: System does not resume operation after RESET.
escalation_guidance: If the system does not resume operation after RESET, stop and escalate to a supervisor/support for further troubleshooting.
